iteration_policy: Integration acceptance reuses the contributor-authored cases and hypotheses after their v1 results were inspected; the derived stress inputs are now explicitly frozen NL-v2. This is a development-only compatibility check, not a new preregistered or held-out effectiveness comparison. The verifier and archived v1 artifacts remain unchanged. No formal v2 run is implied by the plan.
claim_scope: development-scale deterministic comparison of the existing quote-presence and proof-validation pipeline with and without field-level grounding on author-written synthetic families and on derived corruptions of the existing natural-language templates; no extraction-model result, general natural-language-inference, real-traffic, authentication or production-safety claim is allowed

preregistered_hypotheses.H1_fewer_unsafe_executions: on the 48 main cases, the grounded pipeline has fewer automatic executions with a non-Execute gold route than the baseline, in both route settings
preregistered_hypotheses.H2_contradictions_not_accepted: at least 0.75 of gold-CONTRADICTED main focus claims are not accepted as SUPPORTED
preregistered_hypotheses.H3_bounded_false_rejection: at most 0.25 of gold-SUPPORTED main focus claims are rejected or abstained
preregistered_hypotheses.H4_monotone: in every record of both parts, the grounded route is never more permissive than the baseline route
